A worker never edits this block.

structure_extractor.implementation: javax.lang.model + com.sun.source through JavacTask (JdkModelExtract.java, compiled at run time by the toolchain javac)
structure_extractor.note: The pinned toolchain JDK (java_release 21) is the M1 structural extractor; no third-party library. run-jdk-model-extract.sh refuses when the running JDK feature release differs from this pin. The receipt records the extractor source sha256 and the exact runtime string. source_release is the --release level javac attributes the legacy source at (Boot 2.x legacy is Java 8–17 source).

executor.build: mvn -B -o -f .hermes/skills/migration/fix-until-green/typed-repair/pom.xml -Dtyped-repair.build.dir=<a directory OUTSIDE .hermes> package with JDK 21 (built and measured with 21.0.5); project.build.outputTimestamp fixes entry times and the output directory does not enter the jar, so the same sources, dependency jars and JDK give this sha256; a different digest is a new executor and is re-pinned deliberately
executor.runtime: java -jar <jar> --request <request.json> --out <dir> on the workspace JDK 21, offline; no network, no Maven
